verdict.rationale: ADK provides a CLI (`adk run path/to/my_agent`, `adk deploy cloud_run`) and container-based deployment options that support running agents headlessly without a UI, plus evaluation tooling (test files, eval datasets) that suggests CI-friendly workflows. However, there is no explicit CI pipeline example, no documented GitHub Actions/CI integration, and evaluation docs focus on manual dev-time testing rather than automated pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration examples, headless-mode documentation distinct from dev UI, and independent confirmation of CI usage.
